messages.subject: Create shiny app from gadget
parts:
Hi all,

I was wondering if anybody could offer any suggestions on this issue for me.

There is a wonderful package that enables drawing a chemical structure in R via htmlwidgets (https://github.com/zachcp/chemdoodle)

It uses a Shiny Gadget to let the user draw the structure. 

I would like to embed this into a shiny app but am running in to a couple of issues which are outlined in this github issue 

https://github.com/zachcp/chemdoodle/issues/4

Any suggestions would be greatly appreciated. 

Thanks,

Iain
